Product: How to read the fee columns
Marketplace percent is a percentage of the selling price. Marketplace fixed is a flat amount on the same sale.
Processing percent is a percentage of the selling price. Processing fixed is a flat amount, such as a card fee.
Profit per sale = selling price - product - shipping - packaging - both marketplace parts - both processing parts.
Profit margin = profit / selling price. Markup = profit / total cost. They are not the same number.
This sheet does not file taxes and it does not include every fee a marketplace might add later.
